definition.zh: 将准星预先对准敌人可能出现的位置
definition.en: Pre-aim at a position where an enemy is likely to appear.

definition.zh: 控制后坐力，使子弹集中
definition.en: Control weapon recoil to keep shots grouped together.

definition.zh: 只使用近战武器快速移动或突袭
definition.en: Use only a melee weapon to move quickly or make a sudden attack.

definition.zh: 快速突进战术
definition.en: A tactic of rapidly pushing into a position.

definition.zh: 在射击游戏中，指通过听游戏音效来判断敌人位置。
definition.en: Use in-game sounds to determine an enemy's position in a shooter.

definition.zh: 组队一起游戏
definition.en: Form a group and play together.

definition.zh: 分散敌人火力
definition.en: Draw enemy fire in different directions.

definition.zh: 多方向夹击敌人
definition.en: Attack an enemy from multiple directions.

definition.zh: Good Game的缩写，表示游戏结束
definition.en: Short for 'Good Game'; used to mark the end of a game.

definition.zh: 争夺峡谷中的元素龙、远古龙资源
definition.en: Contest elemental drakes and the Elder Dragon on Summoner's Rift.

definition.zh: 移动和普攻交替进行，风筝技巧
definition.en: Alternate movement with basic attacks to kite an opponent.

definition.zh: 从草丛或野区偷袭敌人
definition.en: Ambush an enemy from brush or the jungle.

definition.zh: 主动发起团战
definition.en: Initiate a teamfight.

definition.zh: Attack Damage Carry，主要物理输出角色
definition.en: Attack Damage Carry: a team's main physical-damage dealer.

definition.zh: 控制距离反复消耗
definition.en: Control the distance to opponents while repeatedly wearing them down.

definition.zh: 多名玩家集体作战
definition.en: A fight in which multiple players battle together as a team.

definition.zh: 四人保护一个核心输出
definition.en: Four teammates protect one primary damage dealer.

definition.zh: 大招接闪现
definition.en: Cast an ultimate ability, then follow it with Flash.

definition.zh: 探索地图收集资源
definition.en: Explore the map and gather resources.

definition.zh: 以最快时间完成全游戏流程
definition.en: Complete the full game as quickly as possible.

definition.zh: 改变装备外观但保留属性的系统
definition.en: A system that changes equipment appearance while preserving its stats.

definition.zh: 关注游戏背景和故事的玩家
definition.en: A player interested in a game's setting and story.

definition.zh: 风景党是指喜欢在游戏中欣赏风景、拍照的玩家。
definition.en: A player who enjoys in-game scenery and taking screenshots.
